content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia, with listed diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9.
